User.title: User Profile
User.description: User profile system tracking athlete, coach, brand or federation details

uid.description: The unique user ID matching Firebase Auth uid

username.description: Unique username used for discovery and mentions

displayName.description: The user's full public display name

phone.description: Verified phone number used for OTP authentication

sport.description: Primary sport of interest or coaching expertise

bio.description: Short bio description detailing interests or professional pitch

photoUrl.description: Direct URL to user's profile picture stored in Firebase Storage

coverPhoto.description: Direct URL to user's cover banner image stored in Firebase Storage

verified.description: Whether the profile has been officially verified by Atheleos

followersCount.description: Count of users following this profile

followingCount.description: Count of users this profile is following

postsCount.description: Total count of feed posts created by this user

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp indicating when profile was created

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp indicating last profile modification

/users/{uid}.description: Primary collection storing public and semi-private profiles
